extra.description: The DBS yuu Visa Card is a rewards card designed for everyday spenders who want to earn big on their daily essentials. You can earn up to 18% cash rebates (or 10 miles per S$1) when you spend at yuu partner merchants such as Cold Storage, Giant, Guardian, 7-Eleven, foodpanda, Gojek and SimplyGo, with rewards earned as yuu Points. For all other spend, you earn 1 yuu Point for every S$1 — with no limit and no cap. All yuu Points are automatically credited to your account and can be tracked or redeemed via the yuu app for cash vouchers, lifestyle rewards, or converted to miles. Plus, enjoy a 1-year annual fee waiver to get started.
